top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 90, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
53ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Granfondo Leiria Region – Sico Lands' demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before race day.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 90 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Granfondo Leiria Region – Sico Lands. Train it until it feels boring.
At Granfondo Leiria Region – Sico Lands, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Granfondo Leiria Region – Sico Lands' mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 90 miles.
The aerobic base that lets you ride mixed terrain at tempo for 90 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on mixed terrain. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 90 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,849ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.heat: If the forecast warrants it, include controlled heat exposure before Granfondo Leiria Region – Sico Lands and rehearse the drinking and electrolyte plan you tolerate in training. Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Granfondo Leiria Region – Sico Lands’s 90 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Granfondo Leiria Region – Sico Lands. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, VO2max, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 90 miles of mixed terrain in Pombal, Portugal.
